data.rationale: The proposal follows the right sequence of sites and the right overall goal, but it leaves out the guests parameter naming, the activity1/activity2 split, the companion parameter, and the "review score ≥ 8" hotel rule. It also omits the "do not click Reserve/Book" constraints, treats the note and email text as free-form parameters instead of templates, and says "discard or send" where the true workflow requires Discard, so an automation could not be built from it without guessing.
